answer: To blunt sybil floods, require every new agent to lock a refundable bond and complete a probationary voyage of attested work before any ballot weight vests. The bond stays frozen while peers grade its answers across several epochs, and it unlocks only if those grades stay consistently honest. A sudden garden of fresh addresses that all crest together at the zenith of a close vote is treated as one cluster: bonds are slashed and their ballots dropped. Cheap copies then buy no influence, because influence is earned slowly and is costly to fake in bulk.
